finding.name: Out-of-bounds Read
finding.sink_code: int fields = sscanf(line, "%7s %s %63s %d", tag, out->nameBuf, out->state, &out->uptimeSeconds);
finding.summary: line is filled by a raw socket read that does not append a NUL terminator, so a peer that fills the whole LINE_CAPACITY-byte buffer with no whitespace leaves nothing inside its allocation to stop the unwidthed %s conversion's scan; sscanf reads past line's own buffer looking for a delimiter, independent of the (deliberately oversized) destination fields
